<js>
var html = String(result);
var doc = Packages.org.jsoup.Jsoup.parse(html);
var nr = doc.selectFirst('article#nr');
var lines = [];
if (nr) {
    var rawHtml = String(nr.html());
    rawHtml = rawHtml.replace(/<br\s*\/?>/gi, '\n');
    var parts = rawHtml.split('\n');
    for (var i = 0; i < parts.length; i++) {
        var line = parts[i].replace(/<[^>]+>/g, '').replace(/ /g, ' ').replace(/\u00a0/g, ' ').trim();
        if (line) {
            if (/最新网址|m\.biqukun|本章未完.*继续阅读/.test(line)) continue;
            lines.push(line);
        }
    }
    if (lines.length > 0 && /^第\d+章/.test(lines[0])) {
        lines.shift();
    }
}
lines.join('\n');
</js>

function decode(str) {
  url = source.getKey() + "/api/app/docs-listen/" + str + "/ting-with-efi"; 
  res = JSON.parse(java.ajax(url));
  id = res.id.replaceAll("-", "");
  efi = res.efi;
  cT = res.creationTime.replace(/[-:T.]/g, "").replace(" ", "").padEnd(20, "0");
// 生成key
function gk(e, t) {
  let n = "";
  for (let i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
    n += String.fromCharCode(e[i].charCodeAt(0) + Number(t[i]));
  }
  for (let i = 20; i < e.length; i++) {
    n += String.fromCharCode(e[i].charCodeAt(0) + Number(t[i - 20]));
  }
  return java.base64Encode(n);
}
// 生成iv
function gi(e, t) {
  let n = "";
  for (let i = 20; i > 4; i--) {
    n += String.fromCharCode(e[i].charCodeAt(0) + Number(t[i - 1]));
  }
  return java.base64Encode(n);
}
  key = gk(id, cT); iv = gi(id, cT);
  ef = (efi + "").replace(/\n*$/g, "").replace(/\n/g, "");
